_comment: Portable project MCP configuration for Claude Code, Kimi Code, and compatible clients

simple-pipe-mcp._info: Compiled Simple MCP server exposed under the SPipe-linked name.

simple-lsp-mcp._info: Compiled Simple LSP MCP server (cached native artifact, hash-admitted + tools/call-probed by the wrapper). Measured 2026-08-11 vs the previous source-mode node-bridge launch: startup 0.20s/82.9MB RSS -> 0.03s/4.1MB, lsp_symbols call 4.15s -> 3.68s. SIMPLE_EXECUTION_MODE=interpreter is load-bearing: it is inherited by the query_visibility child, and dropping it regresses the call to 7.96s.

stitch._info: Google Stitch MCP proxy launched through the repo wrapper.
